messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert PD-87421 fired for gpu-node-17 - kernel panic (oom/kernel-oops) and kubelet NotReady. Autopagerduty escalated to primary oncall.

pagerduty-bot: Alert details: service=GPU-Serving, severity=critical, runbook=https://runbooks.internal/gpu-node-panic, links=[https://pd.example/PD-87421].

marie_ops: ack'd. I'm jumping on serial console now, grabbing dmesg + journal.

jonah_oncall: thx marie. quick check — any customer-facing traffic hitting that node? routing shows model-serving-pool-3 had 3 pods on node-17.

infra_bot: kubectl get pods --all-namespaces -o wide | grep gpu-node-17 ->
```
kube-system   kubelet-gpu-node-17   0/1   CrashLoopBackOff   3   5m   10.0.8.17
models        sd-serving-abc        0/2   Pending            0   4m
```

marie_ops: serial console attached, seeing repeated "BUG: kernel NULL pointer dereference" and XID 31/117 messages. grabbing tail of journal: 
```
Mar 11 22:41:02 gpu-node-17 kernel: NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 31, pid=3211, GPU fault at 0x0
Mar 11 22:41:02 gpu-node-17 kernel: kernel panic - not syncing: Fatal exception in interrupt
Mar 11 22:41:02 gpu-node-17 systemd: kubelet.service: main process exited, code=exited, status=1/FAILURE
```

jonah_oncall: ok that's a full host kernel panic. we should cordon and drain anything movable and scale up capacity to avoid customer impact.

sre_lead: Agreed. marie, can you mark node as Unschedulable and trigger drain with --ignore-daemonsets? We'll fallback to model-fleet autoscaler.

marie_ops: running: `kubectl cordon gpu-node-17 && kubectl drain gpu-node-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force`

marie_ops: drain is in progress; pods are evicting. models service scaled replicas from 18 -> 22 to rebalance.

infra_bot: Notifying Dedicated routing layer to stop sending new inference to rack-5 where node-17 lives. Command: `infra-api routes disable --rack rack-5 --reason "node-panic"`

jonah_oncall: customer-impact check: Model latency spike alert fired 22:40 for route /v1/generate; error rate up from 0.4% -> 3.2% in last 3m. most traffic rerouted within 60s but some in-flight requests failed.

sre_lead: Which customers? paging product-support to triage. If any SLAs hit, we need post-incident followup.

marie_ops: product-support alerted, creating support ticket with PD-87421 note. pushing short notification to affected customers via status page draft.

jonah_oncall: any sign of NVMe or power issues on BMC? serial shows repeated GPU faults then panic; doesn't look like disk.

marie_ops: I can try soft-reboot on host after drain completes. proposing to hold off RMA until we gather logs and run memtest.

infra_bot: Running `ipmitool -I lanplus -H 10.1.8.17 -U admin -P **** chassis power status` -> Host is offline after kernel panic triggered watchdog.

marie_ops: ok node is down now. created a snapshot of /var/log/journal and uploaded to s3://incidents/PD-87421/gpu-node-17-journal.tar.gz.

sre_lead: Good. Next steps: 1) Reroute capacity and confirm autoscaler stabilized, 2) collect core and GPU driver debug, 3) arrange RMA if hardware fault persistent.

jonah_oncall: autoscaler note: scaled up 3 standby nodes in pool-3, all healthy; average latency returned to baseline within 4 minutes. marking immediate customer-impact as minimal but some short 5xx spikes observed.

marie_ops: Log excerpts and stack traces attached to ticket. Suspect driver regression; driver version 530.41, kernel 6.1.11. I'll open upstream ticket after incident.

sre_lead: assign followup owners: marie -> postmortem writes, infra -> hardware correlation, eng-ml -> check model quality regressions for affected requests.

marie_ops: ack. I'll start a short incident timeline in the postmortem doc.

pagerduty-bot: PD-87421 status updated: acknowledged by marie_ops, escalated to on-call SRE lead. Incident status: active -> mitigated (host drained, traffic rerouted, autoscale stabilized).

jonah_oncall: handing off to nightly oncall for watch: @sre_night please monitor the rack and check for repeat panics. leaving notes in ops-runbook channel.

sre_lead: thanks team. We'll keep PD open until root cause confirmed. postmortem ETA EOD tomorrow.

incident-bot: Incident closed for oncall shift handoff at 23:12. Follow-up tasks: ["postmortem:PD-87421","rma-eval:gpu-node-17","driver-bisect:gpu-driver-530.41"].

marie_ops: quick note for the postmortem: include kernel oops, XID 31 pattern, and which model requests saw 5xx. I exported a sample request id list to the ticket.

jonah_oncall: thx all. small hiccup, well handled. :thumbsup:
